paragraphs.text: Inkling is a creature type for small creatures made of ink magic.

Inkling was introduced as a token-only creature type in Strixhaven: School of Mages . The creature type returned in Secrets of Strixhaven along with the first non-token Inkling, Inkling Mascot . A second non-token mascot, Scriv, the Obligator , was released as the secondary commander for the Silverquill Influence commander deck.
Inklings are created as mascots by the Silverquill College students of Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios .

These living, inky voids can serve as helpers and pets, but their physical attacks can also be devastating, tearing at an opponent's life force. Their fluid, changeable forms alter to reflect their creator's thoughts and intentions.
After the New Phyrexian Invasion , Silverquill mages updated the inklings so they were less reminiscent of glistening oil . They now resemble calligraphy and illuminated manuscripts.
